projects.name: Legal knowledge, made searchable

projects.name: Answers grounded in enterprise files
projects.summary: Built multi-format ingestion and retrieval for PDFs, images, and Excel files, connecting chunking, embeddings, and semantic search to backend chatbot workflows.
